title: Dominic and the Postcard
author: Theo Sterling
blurb: Tamsin Coldharbour, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
